# function: decode

Parses a string in the dotenv format and returns its entries as a map. Useful together with [`file()`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/functions/file), [`templatefile()`](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/functions/templatefile) or values from other providers.

All supported formats can be found [here](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/germanbrew/dotenv/latest/docs#supported-formats).

Variable references (`$VAR`, `${VAR}`) that are not defined in the content are resolved from the environment of the Terraform process.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Parse the content of a file
locals {
  app = provider::dotenv::decode(file("${path.module}/app.env"))
}

# Parse a rendered template
locals {
  rendered = provider::dotenv::decode(templatefile("${path.module}/app.env.tftpl", {
    environment = "production"
  }))
}

output "database_url" {
  value = local.app["DATABASE_URL"]
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
decode(content string) map of string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `content` (String) Content in the dotenv format
